Everything a geo-grid scan gives you

One scan is a rank at every grid point, your LSOV, ARP and ATRP, a competitor map for every rival, scheduled runs, campaigns, branded PDF and CSV reports, time-lapse GIFs, API keys and team seats — on Google Maps and Apple Maps alike. Below: what you can set, what you get back, and what keeps it running.

Everything one scan gives you

Rank at every grid point

Up to 21 × 21 points around the business, each one its own Google Maps search.

LSOV

The share of grid points where you rank in the top 3, as one number to watch.

ARP and ATRP

Your average rank where you are found, and again with every missed point counted as 21.

Competitors at each point

Who sits above you, point by point, and who does it most often.

Scheduled scans

Put any scan on a timetable. Every run is kept, so the trend builds itself.

Campaigns

Group scans together and follow them as one.

Branded PDF reports

Send a report with your own logo, on a timetable or whenever you need one.

Time-lapse

Every run of a scan, oldest first, as one animated GIF.

API keys

Start scans and read the results from your own code.

Team seats

Invite your team into one organisation, each with their own sign-in.

New

Apple Maps

The same grid, the same numbers, searched on Apple Maps — run a business on both and see the two maps side by side.

The details

What you can set, what you get back, and what it costs.

What it searches

Maps
Google Maps and Apple Maps, each its own scan at the same price.
At every point
The top 20 listings for your keyword, as someone standing there would see them.
Grid size
Always odd, so the business sits on the centre point.9×911×1113×1315×1517×1719×1921×21
Radius
From 0.1 mile, in miles or kilometres, measured from the centre to the edge.
Shape
A square, a circle, or an area you draw. Points outside it are not searched or charged.

What keeps it running

Run again
Any scan, with the same settings, in one click.

Three numbers, every scan

Three numbers a client remembers and a trend that proves your work paid off. Every scan rolls the whole grid into them — no spreadsheet, no hand-waving.

Local Share of Voice
LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

Average Rank, found
ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

Average Total Rank
ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

What does one geo-grid scan give you?

A rank at every grid point, your LSOV, ARP and ATRP, a competitor map for every rival that outranks you, and every export — on Google Maps or Apple Maps.

What can I automate?

Schedules (daily, weekly or monthly), campaigns that group related scans, and alerts when LSOV falls, a rank worsens, points drop out of the top 20, or a rival takes the top 3.

What can I export?

Branded PDF and CSV reports with your own logo, colours and footer, plus a time-lapse GIF stitched from every run of a scan.

Is there an API and team access?

Yes — API keys to start scans and read results from your own code, and team seats with owners, admins and members so a whole team works from the same scans.

How much does it cost to run?

Every plan is a bucket of credits and a scan spends one credit per grid point: 81 credits for a 9 × 9 scan, up to 441 for a 21 × 21. Points you switch off or leave outside your shape cost nothing, and credits you buy never expire.
